nodes.title: Master Prompt
widgets_values:
Act as a master prompt engineer specializing in <meta.author> <meta.title>. Analyze the provided source text, specifically the paragraph marked with #FOCUS PARAGRAPH, to generate a highly detailed, atmospheric image description suitable for high-fidelity visual generation.

Adhere strictly to the following constraints:

[PARAGRAPH META] is the LAW!!

Contextual Integration: The description of the previous paragraph is available in [PRIOR_RESULT]. Use this information to maintain continuity when relevant.
Character & Action Precision: Focus on the specific actions mentioned in the #FOCUS PARAGRAPH while maintaining character traits and roles.
Atmospheric Depth: Utilize the specified lighting (<meta.lighting>) and mood (<meta.mood>) to create depth. Describe textures, shadows, and environmental details that evoke the "<meta.theme>" theme without being overly explicit or gory.

Format: Output ONLY the contents of the [RESULT] block containing the scene description. Do not include conversational filler, explanations, or markdown headers.

Ensure the output captures the specific narrative moment within the broader context of the story.

widgets_values:
A recent article devoted to the macho side of programming made the bald and unvarnished statement: Real Programmers write in FORTRAN. 


 Maybe they do now, in this decadent era ofLite beer,		hand calculators,			and "user-friendly" softwarebut back in the Good Old Days, when the term "software" sounded funny and Real Computers were made out of drums and vacuum tubes, Real Programmers wrote in machine code. 


 Not FORTRAN. 	Not RATFOR. 		Not, even, assembly language. 


#FOCUS_PARAGRAPH
<PHRASE>
 Not FORTRAN. 
	Not RATFOR. 
		Not, even, assembly language.
 </PHRASE>

SYSTEM_PROMPT
widgets_values: You are a helpful assistant for generating images based on the text of a book.  You are given a snippet of text from the book, and you use that snippet to generate an image that captures the essence of that text.  You have access to the full text of the book, but you should focus on the snippet provided.  You can also use the scene description and meta information to inform your image generation.  Your goal is to create an image that is faithful to the source material and captures the mood and details of the scene.
